guides.favoredWhen: She cannot walk up without getting jumped. Hold your engage for her chain-down.

keyTips.text: She cannot walk up without getting jumped: your engage is the threat.
Your shield, tankiness and burst outmatch her: build HP and turn.
Her chain answers your jump: engage after it is spent.

tips.text: Trade the moment she steps in: Q+E punishes walkups.
She holds chain: bait it before committing.
After 6 your all-in out-bursts hers: R when chain is down.
Her W pad splits: after Q+W she must pick a target, so be both.
Jump unanswered plus burst superior: the LeBlanc who never chains you never wins.

sources.rankClaim: Rank 1 LeBlanc, 2941LP Challenger (title); Challenger (profile badge) · LeBlanc main

guides.favoredWhen: He refuses early trades and answers every engage backwards. Poke, bait, then commit.

keyTips.text: He takes no early trades: concede the lane, win the all-in.
After Voltaic he pokes: respect the spike.
His Q curves from his right side: walk into it to make it miss.

early-lane.text: Zed often places Living Shadow before Death Mark so he can swap away from skillshots. Hold your crowd control until he has used the swap.

win-condition.text: Death Mark always lands Zed behind his target. Pre-aim crowd control and escapes behind you, not toward where he cast it.

tips.text: Poke, do not commit early: his backwards combo punishes engages.
Track his W: shadow-down is your engage.
His backwards WEQ answers your jump: bait it before committing.
He holds R to dodge yours: bait the R before committing yours.
Death Mark lands him behind you: E to the exit when he ults.
Engage baited plus R answered: the Zed who never holds answers never kills you.

keyTips.text: Open Raptors into a full clear, then run a second Raptors and Krugs cycle before the first recall.
Spend that recall on Dark Seal plus Blasting Wand, upgrading to Mejai's only when stacks stay safe or a risky comeback demands it.
Play tank Diana to absorb pressure through defenses aimed at the damage that can actually reach her.

tips.text: Take Flash and Smite, treating Flash as the practical escape tool.
Start the Dusk and Dawn path through Blasting Wand, Ruby Crystal, Dagger, and Sheen.
With no lane-state gank route or objective schedule given, pick a full-clear direction that tracks the enemy jungler and keeps a nearby lane reachable.
Buy Riftmaker second on the tank setup for damage that scales with the defense bought afterward.
Default to Plated Steelcaps, switching to Mercury's Treads once enemy crowd control justifies them.
Buy Randuin's Omen into multiple critical threats and Thornmail into healing or on-hit attackers.
Take Unending Despair as the general armor pick outside those cases, usually with Spirit Visage unless Kaenic Rookern fits better.
Favor Spirit Visage as the general magic-resistance pick around allied healing or shielding, and Kaenic Rookern when burst protection matters more.
Reserve Force of Nature for heavy damage-over-time or burn teams, skipping it when Diana dies before its stacking pays off.
When even full defense cannot survive, pivot toward the bruiser damage setup instead.
Pick AP Diana through Nashor's Tooth, Sorcerer's Shoes, Rabadon's Deathcap, and Zhonya's Hourglass when the team needs offense.
On AP Diana, buy Zhonya's for dives, especially when stasis lets Moonfall damage resolve before displacements land.
Protect the Dark Seal lead and never rush Mejai's while deaths remain likely.

itemization.text: Run the tank page of Conqueror, Triumph, Legend: Haste, and Cut Down with Absolute Focus and Waterwalking.
Build Dusk and Dawn into Plated Steelcaps and Riftmaker, then two defenses from Randuin's Omen, Kaenic Rookern, Spirit Visage, Force of Nature, Thornmail, and Frozen Heart.
Add Spirit Visage with enchanter or healing support behind the long-fight plan, or Kaenic Rookern into concentrated burst.
Start the alternate AP build on Nashor's Tooth, Sorcerer's Shoes, Rabadon's Deathcap, and Zhonya's when Diana can survive the entry and the team needs damage.

keyTips.text: Land Q first so E finds a marked target, refunds its cooldown, and enables another dash.
Initiate teamfights with R, whose pull also threatens several enemies at once.
Hold R until Flash, blink, and dash escapes are spent, since its delay lets those tools dodge it.

tips.text: Treat passive stacks as the lane and early-fight currency on either the AP or attack-speed build.
Dash through targets with Q, keeping the reset line in mind when other damage kills the target mid-dash.
Soak AP dives with Defiant Dance, which also answers back while charged.
Read W as physical damage with less value into heavy armor, and hold it as defense there when needed.
Delay the second E blade to stretch the stun setup, and open from out of vision so the catch stays hard to read.
After a confirmed E stun, start charging W at once and follow with R near its peak charge.
Respect the flagged gank vulnerability before extending for lane pressure.
Never assume free shoves into pressure; waveclear is weak against it.
Split time between side pressure and grouping by map state, since Diana fits both.
Treat the first one to three core items as the labeled power spike.
Run the AP path from Sorcerer's Shoes and Lich Bane into Shadowflame and Rabadon's Deathcap.
Take the second path of Liandry's Torment, Riftmaker, and Shadowflame into tanks or bruisers.
Keep access rolling in skirmishes with Q-hit E resets for repeated dashes.
Let each pulled champion raise Moonfall damage, so multi-target casts pay best.
Convert openings with a Q-enabled E reset for follow-up access after the strong side-lane and burst value carries in.
Land skillshots before committing, since the AP build depends on them and escapes run short.
Zone a key enemy with R or catch several, parking the main target where follow-up damage lands.
Guard W as a defensive cooldown too, since Diana turns very squishy while it stays down.

itemization.text: Run Stormraider's Surge with Manaflow Band, Transcendence, and Gathering Storm plus Shield Bash and Conditioning.
Take Flash and Ignite as the aggressive summoner setup.
Hold Zhonya's Hourglass, Void Staff, and Banshee's Veil as situational defense and resistance answers.
For the bruiser route, use Conqueror with Resolve or Stormraider's Surge; one Conqueror setup runs Presence of Mind, Legend: Haste, Last Stand, Shield Bash, and Overgrowth.
